## About
Stl Auto Care Inc is a local repair shop on Gravois Rd in St. Louis, serving drivers in Affton and around the neighborhood. We work on brakes, transmissions, exhaust, air conditioning and the routine maintenance that keeps your car dependable.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 86 Google reviews. One reviewer called the owner honest and reliable, and another said he explained the part that caused the problem. That is how we like to work: fix it, tell you what happened, and get you back on the road.

## Services
- Brake repair: Your brakes are critical to driving safely. We handle brake repairs quickly and carefully.
- Transmissions: If your transmission needs work, our certified technicians can take care of it and get you back on the road.
- Routine maintenance: Regular care so your car is there for you when you need it.
- Diagnostics: Something feels off or a light is on. We will track down the cause.
- Exhaust and air conditioning: We also work on exhaust systems and car air conditioning.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We are closed Saturday and Sunday and open Monday through Friday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We are at 8500 Gravois Rd in St. Louis, close to Affton.

Q: Can I reach you by email?
A: Yes. You can email us at stlautocare@att.net.
